name: triptych-api
description: Dedicated Cloudflare Worker for The Triptych agent node (Castor, Pollux, Gem). Handles Mem0 context retrieval, Gemini 1.5 Pro generation, and memory banner scraping/commit.

routes.description: Main chat endpoint. Receives POST from Castor Hub, retrieves Mem0 context, generates via Gemini, scrapes for memory banner, and returns final JSON.
